windowTitle: TKE minimal closure - the administrator refund-policy list answered 502 once one refund policy version existed
workingTreeNote: Shared uncommitted worktree. Parallel windows hold concurrent edits outside this write set (apps/console-bff/internal/httpapi). This receipt covers only the refund-policy readback write set.

rootCause.fact: `scanRefundPolicy` resolved the stored `algorithm` column with a single lookup key: `"REFUND_POLICY_VERSION_ALGORITHM_ENUM_" + upper(algorithm)`. The column stores the contract's hyphenated literal `workspace-delete-refund-v1` (the same literal `CreateRefundPolicyVersion` writes), while the wire enum member is spelled `REFUND_POLICY_VERSION_ALGORITHM_ENUM_WORKSPACE_DELETE_REFUND_V1`. The lookup therefore missed, `api.RefundPolicyVersionAlgorithmEnum_value[...]` answered the map zero value, and the row was silently read back as `..._UNSPECIFIED`.
rootCause.consequence: `algorithm` is a required public property of `RefundPolicyVersion` in `packages/contracts/go/publicjson/shape_generated.go`, so the public encoder refuses a page whose row resolved to the unspecified member (`required property RefundPolicyVersion.algorithm has no public value for REFUND_POLICY_VERSION_ALGORITHM_ENUM_UNSPECIFIED`). The Console BFF `GET /api/v2/admin/catalog/refund-policies` therefore answered 502 for as long as one refund policy version existed, and 200 while the table was empty. Quote and Launch were unaffected because the quote resolution carries `refundPolicyVersionId` and the customer-terms text rather than re-encoding the algorithm member.
rootCause.canonicalOwnership: The Resource Catalog owner owns both the stored spelling and the wire projection. The fix belongs in `scanRefundPolicy`, next to the unchanged `planChangePolicyVersionEnum`, which already had to bridge the same hyphen/underscore difference for `plan_change_policy_version`.

change.shape: `scanRefundPolicy` now normalizes the stored separator (`strings.ReplaceAll(algorithm, "-", "_")`, upper-cased) and only accepts a table hit, falling back to the explicit `REFUND_POLICY_VERSION_ALGORITHM_ENUM_UNSPECIFIED` member when the stored value names no wire member. Same shape as the existing `planChangePolicyVersionEnum`.
change.closedSeam: The public seam is the existing owner read plus shared encoder, exercised by the new `TestListRefundPolicyVersionsReadsBackTheStoredRefundAlgorithm` through the production `CreateRefundPolicyVersion` -> `ListRefundPolicyVersions` -> `publicjson.Marshal` path on a real isolated owner database. No contract, schema, migration, fallback layer, or compatibility branch was added.
